instruction_bn: clause/phrase দিয়ে বাক্যটি সম্পূর্ণ করো (Test Paper থেকে সংগৃহীত)।

a: would have got a good result
items.rule_bn: Past unreal: Had + V3, ... would have + V3।
প্রবাদ: Where there is a will, there is a way।

items.q: Without ___, you can never expect a good result.
You can't succeed in life unless ___.
If we lose the morning hours of life, ___.
No sooner had they passed the HSC examination ___.
a: than they got admitted to university
than they were admitted to university
items.rule_bn: 'No sooner had ... than' — than-এর পরে past simple।
প্রবাদ: Allah helps those who help themselves।

items.q: You should rise early so that ___.
a: you can enjoy the fresh air
you can do your work in time

items.q: A student has to study regularly lest ___.
